title: Sheep holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='40%' cy='35%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fa3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e63950'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M68 30 Q64 45 60 55' fill='none' stroke='#ffe6a8' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='20' rx='13' ry='16' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <path d='M66.5 35 L70 40 L73.5 35 Z' fill='#c22d42'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='14' rx='3' ry='4.5' fill='#ffc2cc' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- sheep body (wool) -->
  <g fill='#f4f1e8'>
    <circle cx='40' cy='62' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='60' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='33' cy='72' r='11'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='74' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='71' r='11'/>
  </g>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='82' width='5' height='11' rx='2.5' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='47' y='82' width='5' height='11' rx='2.5' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='55' y='82' width='5' height='11' rx='2.5' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='57' rx='9' ry='8.5' fill='#5c4432'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='55' r='1.8' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='55' r='1.8' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='55.5' r='0.9' fill='#2a1d14'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='55.5' r='0.9' fill='#2a1d14'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='61' rx='2' ry='1.4' fill='#c98b8b'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='53' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#4a3628' transform='rotate(-20 25 53)'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='53' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#4a3628' transform='rotate(20 41 53)'/>
  <!-- wool tuft on head -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='49' r='4' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='48' r='4' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <path d='M60 55 Q64 50 66 44' fill='none' stroke='#7a5a3a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
